versions.changelog:
Initial release of the YouTube upload skill.

- Upload or schedule videos, including Shorts, directly to YouTube via PostWire's official integration—no Google Cloud project, OAuth setup, or browser automation needed.
- Supports uploading from a public video link, user device, or by generating a Short from text.
- Customizable title, description, and privacy settings (public, unlisted, private).
- Also offers the option to publish the same video to TikTok and Instagram Reels.
- Requires a free PostWire account with a connected YouTube channel.
